v.q: What wins when one policy allows and another explicitly denies?
v.w: An explicit deny always overrides every allow.

v.q: How does a service control policy affect a role with AdministratorAccess?
v.w: It only limits. A request still needs an allow in the account.

v.q: How should a CI pipeline get AWS access without stored keys?
v.w: The pipeline presents a signed token and assumes a role for about an hour.

v.q: Which grants a Fargate task its permissions?
v.w: The execution role only pulls the image and writes logs.

v.q: How should engineers get access to many accounts?
v.w: Permission sets become temporary roles, and access ends when the directory entry is removed.
